name: agent-tools-verify
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/agent-tools/tsconfig.json > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/typecheck.log" 2>&1; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < research/agent-tools/COMMIT.txt > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commitlint.log" 2>&1; bun --version > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/bun-version.txt"; GDP_WORK_FULL=1 bun test research/agent-tools/protocol.test.ts research/agent-tools/service.test.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1; bun research/agent-tools/scripted-session.ts --out "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/session.json" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/session-summary.json"
